purpose: Teach: 谷口/柳沢/奥田/新井/荒木/浅野/村山/大田

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 谷口部長の歓迎会を来週設定しましょう
lines.en: Let's schedule the welcome reception for the new department director Taniguchi for next week.
lines.style: Efficient, businesslike. Crisp attack on the opening. Matter-of-fact pace. Leader-voice—delegating with quiet authority, not asking but directing with courtesy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。柳沢課長の引き継ぎ書を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll confirm the handover documentation from Manager Yanagisawa.
lines.style: Attentive, responsive. Slight nod in the voice on 「はい」. Steady, reliable tempo. The note-taker's tone—present and following, not performative.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 奥田主任のプロジェクト進捗を週次で確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's check in weekly on the progress of Team Lead Okuda's project.
lines.style: Clear directive. Sharp emphasis on the action-item. Moderate pace, forward momentum. Assuming agreement—not checking for permission, trusting competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新井広報の月次レポートを受け取ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll collect the monthly report from the PR department—Arai.
lines.style: Smooth, efficient. Clean continuation. Slight lift on the name—placing it clearly for the record. Businesslike but not cold—doing the work reliably.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 荒木人事の新任研修計画を相談しましょう
lines.en: Let's discuss the new-hire training plan with HR—Araki.
lines.style: Directive but collaborative. Slight pause before the shared action. Steady voice, calm authority. The tone of someone who values input but keeps things moving.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。浅野経理の予算配分を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll review the budget allocation from Accounting—Asano.
lines.style: Consistent, steady affirmation. Even tempo. The reliable anchor-voice. Matching the rhythm established—competent and present without flourish.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 村山海外担当の出張報告を共有しましょう
lines.en: Let's share the overseas assignment trip report from Murayama.
lines.style: Same directing energy as the first four proposals. Slight pause for emphasis on "share." Inclusive—this isn't just information, it's collaborative knowledge transfer.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。大田法務の契約レビューを進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll move forward with the contract review from Legal—Ota.
lines.style: Closing note. Slight weight on 「進めます」—there's momentum building. Solid, assured tempo. The final affirmation that wraps the meeting up with intention.
